extracted.name: Kumquats
extracted.description: Enjoy this easy recipe for kumquats. This fruit is entirely edible when ripe, rind and all, though the seeds should be removed. Eat as-is or sliced.
instruction_lines: Wash kumquats and cover with water in a non-aluminum saucepan. Bring to a boil and simmer for 30 minutes.
Add sugar and cinnamon, return to a boil, and cook for 5 minutes. Remove from heat and drain.
